# Card

> Content surface for panels, tiles, and settings groups.

This file matches the installed `card` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/card.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/card.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/card-knobs`: `cardKnobs`, types `CardKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/card`: `Card`, `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter`, `CardLink`, types `CardVariant`, `CardSize`, `CardProps`, `CardHeaderProps`, `CardTitleProps`, `CardDescriptionProps`, `CardActionProps`, `CardContentProps`, `CardFooterProps`, `CardLinkProps`

## Composition

### Panel anatomy

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle />
    <CardDescription />
    <CardAction />
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent />
  <CardFooter />
</Card>
```

### Clickable card

CardLink turns the whole card into its hit area: the card paints --cui-card-hover-background on hover and the focus ring while the link has focus. It renders a button; pass render={<a href />} to navigate. Other buttons, links, inputs, and checkboxes in the card stay clickable above it.

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>
      <CardLink />
    </CardTitle>
    <CardDescription />
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent />
</Card>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Badge } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/card";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveCardExample() {
  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Pro plan</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>Everything you need to ship agents.</CardDescription>
        <CardAction>
          <Badge>Popular</Badge>
        </CardAction>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <Text as="p" size="heading-2">
          $29
          <Text weight="normal" tone="muted">
            /mo
          </Text>
        </Text>
      </CardContent>
      <CardFooter>
        <Text tone="muted">Billed monthly. Cancel anytime.</Text>
      </CardFooter>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `card`
  - `action`
  - `content`
  - `description`
  - `footer`
  - `header`
  - `link`: `data-focus-ring` (`none`)
  - `root`: `data-size` (`default` | `sm`), `data-variant` (`default` | `sectioned`)
  - `title`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### card

- `--cui-card-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)`
- `--cui-card-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-card-foreground`: `var(--card-foreground)`
- `--cui-card-section-border-color`: `oklch(from var(--border) l c h / 0.7)`
- `--cui-card-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-card-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-card-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-card-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)`
- `--cui-card-backdrop-filter`: `none`
- `--cui-card-padding-block`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 6)`
- `--cui-card-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 6)`
- `--cui-card-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 6)`
- `--cui-card-title-font-size`: `1em`
